description: List one account's membership history — level, term, start and end dates, fee, status (e.g. SUCCEEDED/FAILED) and auto-renewal. Filter to active or the primary active membership. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/memberships.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

is_active.description: Only memberships matching the account's Active member flag.
